verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a self-hosted deployment in which you run and control the infrastructure that stores your AI data, aimed at data-residency and compliance needs. The UI, authentication and platform updates remain managed by Braintrust, so this is a hybrid data-plane deployment rather than a fully self-hosted core product. Missing for 10: fully self-hosted control plane (UI, auth, platform management), air-gapped or offline deployment, deployment details (supported clouds, install method), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
